items.title: Jerry Dodgion interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Well in the saxophones there’s Frank Wess and Dick Oatts, Ralph LaLama, Gary Smulyan.

ctx.x: Talk to him, yeah. Who else is playing in that group?
Well in the saxophones there’s Frank Wess and Dick Oatts, Ralph LaLama, Gary Smulyan. Slide Hampton’s in the band and he writes for the band too which is —
We know that. We heard that the other night.
